name: RhythmStrike
description:
About This Game

RhythmStrike is a vertical-scrolling rhythm game inspired by modern Japanese arcade titles. Designed to push the limits of mouse and keyboard mechanics, RhythmStrike features music from renowned rhythm game artists such as t+pazolite, LeaF, and EBIMAYO.

[GAMEPLAY]

Tap incoming notes with your keyboard while tracking the rhythm from side to side with your mouse. Beginners start with simple mouse tracking and tapping, while veterans navigate hybrid charts that shift between standard 6K and 3K+Mouse sections. As you play, visual effects trigger in sync with the track, altering the visuals in real time.

[MISSION MODE]

Progress through a dedicated challenge campaign. Clear songs by surviving miss limits, hitting combo thresholds, or maintaining precise accuracy and unlock hidden content.

[FEATURES]

  • 6K and 3K+Mouse hybrid rhythm game mechanics.

  • Licensed tracks from artists like t+pazolite, LeaF, and EBIMAYO.

  • Mission Mode: Progress through challenges to unlock new content.

  • Music-synced visual effects.

  • Global leaderboards and a personal skill rating system.

  • Deep customization settings.

  • Community Discord server for sharing scores, and feedback.
short_desc: Vertical-scrolling rhythm game inspired by modern Japanese arcade titles, featuring hybrid keyboard and mouse mechanics and music-synced visual effects. Climb the global leaderboards and unlock new content through specialized challenges!
